column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!”
Close to the Hebrew; “who makes high to sit” is rendered “Who dwells on high.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who makes low to look” is rendered “Who humbles Himself to behold,” and NKJV supplies “The things that are.”
Close to the Hebrew; עִם־ נְדִיבִים (“with nobles”) is rendered “with princes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “causes the barren of the house to dwell” is rendered “grants the barren woman a home,” and “the joyful mother” “Like a joyful mother.”
